newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Modelo names director general.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Modelo names director general.

text.p: Mexico's Grupo Modelo on Wednesday said its board named Carlos Fernandez Gonzalez as the brewing company's director general.
In its statement, the company did not say whom Fernandez Gonzalez was replacing, and officials could not be immediately reached for further comment.
Modelo said in a statement that Juan Sanchez Navarro Redo was also named director of public relations.
Antonino Fernandez Rodriguez will remain chairman of the board and executive president, posts he has held since 1971, the company said.
((--Tomas de la Rosa, Mexico City newsroom +525 728 7912))
